title: Inform payroll of moves abroad
goal: Payroll is told about every move abroad, so it can check for source tax, and is not told about moves within Switzerland.
context: When an employee moves abroad, they may have to pay source tax, so payroll must know (F-TR-010, F-TR-011, F-TR-012). Moves within Switzerland do not concern payroll (F-TR-017). This feature uses the new country captured in FEAT-01. Payroll's needs are known only second-hand from HR, and HR said the list is complete only 'for now' (F-TR-022). We have not yet asked payroll whether it also needs the valid-from date or the full foreign address (OQ-06).

stories.title: Payroll learns about every move abroad
stories.i_want: to be informed whenever an employee reports a move to a country other than Switzerland, including the new country of residence
stories.so_that: I can check whether the employee now has to pay source tax
stories.priority_reason: HR stated this as a firm requirement ('payroll has to be informed'). If payroll is not told, source tax may be missed for employees who move abroad.

acceptance_criteria.title: Payroll is informed when the new country is not Switzerland
acceptance_criteria.given: an employee reports a change of address and gives a new country other than Switzerland
acceptance_criteria.then: payroll is informed of the move abroad, because the employee may have to pay source tax

acceptance_criteria.title: Payroll receives the new country of residence
acceptance_criteria.given: payroll is informed of a move abroad
acceptance_criteria.then: it includes the new country of residence, given by its English name (for example "Germany"). Whether payroll also needs the valid-from date or the full foreign address is not yet decided (see OQ-06).

stories.title: Payroll is not told about moves within Switzerland
stories.i_want: payroll to be informed only about moves abroad and not about moves within Switzerland
stories.so_that: payroll only gets information it needs for source tax, and employees' address data is shared no more than necessary
stories.priority_reason: This follows from the stated rule and from data minimisation. It avoids needless work and sharing, but nothing is blocked if it is missing.

acceptance_criteria.title: Payroll is not informed when the new country is Switzerland
acceptance_criteria.given: an employee reports a change of address and gives Switzerland as the new country
acceptance_criteria.then: payroll is not informed of the move
